notes:
Summary: Closed-lost for now. Primary reason: customer observed a measurable quality regression vs incumbent (Anthropic) during our POC on structured outputs and tool-calling. Key excerpts below.

POC takeaways (customer quotes):
- 'Function call behavior was inconsistent — callbacks misordered, extra args injected.'
- 'We lost 8% extraction accuracy on our Golden Prompt set vs incumbent.'
- 'Output schema drift — created downstream parsing errors.'

Security:
- Heavy emphasis on on-prem/VPC with HSM/KMS for PII. Security requested an on-site architecture review; we delivered draft but final HSM integration plan not approved.
- Legal wanted retention controls + data residency SLA (must remain in us-east-1).

Commercial & org:
- Internal champion (Dir. of AI Ops) left during procurement review. No clear exec sponsor now.
- CFO put a hiring/budget freeze for Q1; procurement paused all new contracts.

Sales activity notes (shorthand):
- 2025-01-07: Intro call (Jordan) — high-level fit, asked for dedicated/private options.
- 2025-01-12: Deep POC kickoff (SE: Priya) — ingest pipeline test, tool-calling scenario. Fireflies: ff-2025-01-12-321.
- 2025-01-29: Mid-POC sync — reported structured output regression vs Anthropic baseline.
- 2025-02-02: Security review (Evan joined) — provided security FAQ + draft KMS/HSM plan. Fireflies: ff-2025-02-02-118.
- 2025-02-10: Final demo — customer prefers incumbent for now due to quality and stability.
- 2025-02-14: AE attempted re-engage by email (no reply).

Proposed mitigations discussed with customer:
- Custom Golden Prompt regression tests and pre-commit evals.
- Lock model version + fallback routing to incumbent for critical flows.
- Sandbox tool-calling harness (deterministic rollout) to prevent extra args/hallucinations.
- Dedicated on-prem tenant with HSM-backed keys and residency guarantee.

Why we lost: mix of model quality (structured-output + tool-calling), incomplete HSM/integration plan for security, budget freeze, and loss of internal champion.

Action: mark closed-lost, document POC failure cases in repo (RDW-2981), send condensed eval report to buyer list and set nurture cadence 6 months out.
